一、情景用语与口语

开篇：时代广场的艺术作品

课本开篇 · 1

Look at the photo of an artwork. What is the red shape?

看这件艺术作品的照片：红色的形状是什么？

New York ♥ immigrants: artwork in Times Square, New York

课本开篇 · 4

口语

Are you and your family from the city or country you live in now? Tell your partner.

你和你的家人来自你现在住的城市或国家吗？告诉同伴。

A: I live here in São Paulo, but my family is from Rio de Janeiro.
B: My grandparents are from Portugal.

一、情景用语与口语

9a / 9b：过去的“第一次”和重要的人

课本 9a · 11

口语

Ask and answer questions with who/what about your past.

用 who / what 问答关于你过去的事。

• your first friends at primary school / high school / university
• your first toy
• your first school
• your first holiday
• your first job

A: Who were your first friends at primary school?
B: They were Jen and Alex.

课本 9b · 1

口语

Work in pairs. Who was important to you in the past? Tell your partner their names.

两人一组：过去谁对你很重要？告诉同伴他们的名字。

a celebrity　a sportsperson　a friend　a teacher　an author　someone in your family

A: Mrs Torres was important to me.
B: Who was she?
A: She was my sports teacher.

一、情景用语与口语

9b / 9c：重要的人和重要的日子

课本 9b · 10

口语

Work in groups. Write the names of the people from your past in Exercise 1 on pieces of paper. Take turns to read a name. Ask and answer the questions about the names.

小组活动：把练习 1 里你过去重要的人的名字写在纸条上，轮流读一个名字，就这个人问答。

A: Why was Monika Gomes important?
B: She was my first teacher. She was funny and nice. She helped me a lot.

课本 9c · 10

口语

Think of three important dates from your life. Where were you? Who were you with? What happened?

想三个你生命中重要的日子：你在哪里？和谁在一起？发生了什么？

课本 9c · 11

口语

Work in groups. Take turns to talk about one of the important dates.

小组活动：轮流讲讲其中一个重要的日子。

This was on the 19th of April, last year. I passed my driving test! I was with my parents and my sister.

一、情景用语与口语

9d：昨天九点你在哪里？

课本 9d · 2

口语

Work in pairs. Ask and answer questions with the photos in Exercise 1.

两人一组：用练习 1 的照片问答。

练习 1 的短语：At nine o’clock yesterday, I was …
1 on a train　2 at home　3 busy
4 in traffic　5 not well　6 on the phone

A: Where were you at nine o’clock yesterday?
B: I was in traffic.

9d：道歉和接受道歉

课本 9d · 4

听力 9.12

Listen again and complete the extracts from the conversations with expressions for apologizing.

再听一遍，用道歉的说法补全对话片段。

1 I’m sorry I’m late. ____________
2 Oh, I’m sorry. ____________
3 I’m very sorry. ____________

APOLOGIZINGACCEPTING APOLOGIES
I’m sorry I’m late.
I’m (very) sorry.
The train was late.
I was (very) busy.
We weren’t at home.		That’s OK.
It’s OK.
Don’t worry.

课本 9d · 6

口语

Work in pairs. Practise conversations starting with Where were you …? and these times. Use the vocabulary in Exercise 1.

两人一组：用 Where were you …? 和下面的时间练习对话，用上练习 1 的词。

this morning　at lunchtime　at three thirty　last night　on Sunday afternoon　yesterday

A: Where were you this morning? I waited for you.
B: Oh, I’m sorry …

一、情景用语与口语

9f：你怎样使用这些东西？

课本 9f · 7

口语

Work in groups. Look at the photos (a–f) and the questions (1–4). Talk about how you use things in your daily life.

小组活动：看图片 a–f 和问题 1–4，谈谈你日常怎样使用这些东西。

1 How often do you buy or use these things?

课本 9f · 11

口语

Feedback: Is it easy to change how much plastic we use? Why? / Why not?

反馈：改变我们使用塑料的多少容易吗？为什么？

一、情景用语与口语

9f：小组项目 Project

课本 9f · 8–10

口语

Project brief: Give a presentation about the plastic people use every day.

小组项目：做一个关于人们每天使用的塑料的展示。

8 Research　Work in groups. Look at the plastic things you have in your bag and in your classroom. Make a list of:
• the items that are plastic
• the plastic things you used last week
• the items you use only once
• items that aren’t plastic you can use for at least three of the things on your list.
9 Planning　In your group, prepare a visual on your computer. Show some of the items from your research. Use photos or your own pictures. Say:
• what you do with the plastic after you use it.
• what alternatives you can use instead of plastic.
10 Presentation　Give your presentation. Show your visual to the class.

These are the plastic things we used last week. We decided that we can use paper bags not plastic bags. And we can take a re-usable water bottle every day.

口语

语法 Grammar

be 动词过去式 was / were · was / were 疑问句 · 一般过去时：规则动词 · there was / there were

二、语法 · was / were

课本 9a：找 be 的过去式、选一选

课本 9a · 4

Look at the grammar box. Underline the past forms of be in the quiz.

看语法框，在小测验里给 be 的过去式画线。

When was the first …?　When was the first social media app? Do you know? Do the quiz. Test your knowledge!
1 The first social media app was Talkomatic, in ______. It wasn’t for everyone to use – it was only for people at the University of Illinois in the United States.　a 1973　b 2002　c 2011
2 The first plastic money was Australian, in ______. It was a ten dollar note.　a 1976　b 1988　c 2001
3 The first commercial plastic bottles, in ______, were expensive. But they were great for liquids and after a few years, they were very popular.　a 1747　b 1847　c 1947
4 The first electric cars were French and German. The engineers were Gustave Trouvé and Andres Flocken. In ______ the Flocken Elektrowagen was the first four-wheeled electric car in the world. Electric cars were fast and they weren’t difficult to drive.　a 1888　b 1913　c 1980

课本 9a · 5

Choose the correct option.

选择正确的选项。

1 Plastic water bottles was / were expensive at first.
2 The first social media app was / were Talkomatic.
3 Electric cars wasn’t / weren’t difficult to drive.
4 Brazil was / wasn’t the first country to have plastic money.

课本 9a · 6

Write true sentences with the correct past form of be.

用 be 的正确过去式写出真实的句子。

1 The first electric car ______ British.
2 Gustave Trouvé ______ an engineer.
3 Electric cars ______ fast.
4 Before 1947, plastic bottles ______ popular.

二、语法 · was / were

书后语法练习

书后语法 · 1

Complete the paragraph with was or were.

用 was 或 were 补全短文。

Sally Ride 1______ the first American woman in space. She 2______ born in 1951. Her parents 3______ from California. Her first space flight 4______ in 1983. She 5______ the writer of six books for children. They 6______ about space and science.

书后语法 · 2

Rewrite the sentences in the form given in brackets.

按括号要求改写句子（negative 否定 / affirmative 肯定）。

1 Haruki’s favourite teacher was Mr Lee. (negative)
　→ Haruki’s favourite teacher wasn’t Mr Lee.（例）
2 I wasn’t at home yesterday. (affirmative)
3 Tran’s parents weren’t TV presenters. (affirmative)
4 She wasn’t a famous photographer. (affirmative)
5 My friends were late to school. (negative)
6 I was a good student at school. (negative)

A　The new weekend is one year old!
1st January 2023
Last year, 1st January was an important day for people in the United Arab Emirates. The country changed its weekend. Before, the two days of the weekend were Friday and Saturday. Now they are Saturday and Sunday. Government offices and many businesses started a new timetable. After one year, people think it’s good for international business. For some people, it was difficult in the beginning, but now they are happy with the change.

B　New Year, new calendar
31st December 2011
There was a big change in Samoa this week. This Pacific Island country changed its time zone! It was 23 hours behind New Zealand, but now it’s one hour ahead. This means that there were only 30 days in December in Samoa this year. The calendar jumped from 29th December to 31st December. Every 1st January, Samoa was one of the last countries to celebrate New Year. Now, in a different time zone, it’s one of the first.
time zone (noun) /ˈtaɪm zəʊn/ one of 24 areas in the world with a different time

C　Country changes people’s ages
28th June 2023
People in South Korea changed their ages on Wednesday. In the past, there were two rules for counting a person’s age. Everyone started at the number one when they were born. There was a year added every 1st of January. Now, South Korea uses an international system. One year after you are born, you are one year old. This father is now 44 and his son is 9. The change is popular: 75 per cent of South Koreans agreed with it.

六、阅读

单元测试阅读：音乐与我

When I was a child, my favourite singer was Bruce Springsteen. I loved his music and listened to his CDs all the time. My mother is a piano teacher and a singing teacher, so she helped me learn to sing his songs.
We moved to France when I was twelve because my father started a job with a company in Paris. We lived there for ten years. I listened to lots of music by French groups: my favourite was a rock and roll group from Toulouse – they were great! I saw them five times when they were in concert in Paris. I also learned to play the guitar because I started a band with some friends. We weren’t very good!
Music is still important for me. I always listen to music when I drive. I’m a taxi driver, and the music helps me relax in traffic. I sometimes play the guitar in a musical group, and I imagine I’m great like Bruce!

写

Read the prompt. Write your answer in 50–60 words.

Imagine your friend, Frank, sent you an email:
Hi!
How are you? I’m very sorry about last night. I wasn’t well so I stayed at home. I know you wanted to do something special. Did you go to the cinema or a concert, or something different?
Do you want to do something together soon? What do you want to do?
Best wishes
Frank

Write a reply. In your answer, you should:
• reply to Frank about not being well
• answer all of his questions
• remember to start and end your reply with the correct expressions.
